title: pkg/machine/env: add test coverage for the machine dir path helpers
body:
`pkg/machine/env` builds the filesystem paths used by `podman machine`, but has
no unit tests. A couple of its helpers are pure and worth pinning down:

- `WithPodmanPrefix` prepends `podman-` only when the name does not already start
  with `podman` — so `machine` → `podman-machine`, but `podman-machine`,
  `podman`, and even `podmanx` are left unchanged. This is subtle and easy to
  regress.
- `DataDirPrefix` / `ConfDirPrefix` return the machine data/config path prefix,
  which should end with `containers/podman/machine`.

Add unit tests for these. Pure-Go, no behaviour change; `go test ./pkg/machine/env/`
passes (runs natively, no VM needed).
